question: Does the fixed shrunk profile offset improve equal-reader rating prediction over the fixed shrunk item mean on different readers?

cohort.selection: Exclude all prior cohort subjects first; rank remaining eligible subjects by SHA256(seed + colon + numeric ID), deduplicate the first 2000 candidates, then retain first 500 complete eligible histories. Never search seeds after scores.

split: Label-blind subject/item hash masks: 100 subjects excluded from every global fit and validation; regular histories 70/15/15 train/validation/development holdout; cold histories 80/20 visible evidence/fixed targets. No temporal interpretation.
scaleTransform: twice preserved original rating; no observed zeros
coldEvidenceMeaning: Number of visible ratings, never an allowed-grade list; fixed targets at every budget
bootstrapUnit: paired subjects; equal subject weight; percentile 95% interval

decision.rationale: Conservative DEVELOPMENT margins fixed before the disjoint cohort, informed by the exposed pilot's ~0.18 row-RMSE gain and ~0.12–0.27 grouped gain interval. Not a native product-value threshold.
decision.rule: Select challenger only if validation passes all primary/MAE/interval/coverage checks. Save selection before holdout scoring. Continue it as an offline research baseline only if the same holdout checks and every cold guard pass; otherwise retain control. No serving admission.

admission: NONE; external development comparison, never native FINAL, causal recommendation benefit or calibrated confidence
